title: Regression fitting, regularization and held-out assessment
outcome: Fit a small regression procedure with stable linear algebra and select regularization without using final outcomes.

exercises.title: Recover the known model
exercises.task: Fit the exact line without a penalty.
exercises.hint: Use the authored equation as an independent reference.
exercises.answer: A correct numerical recovery validates this fixture, not a population inference.

exercises.title: Trace penalty selection
exercises.task: Compare all four development errors in case B.
exercises.hint: Use only the development labels for the choice.
exercises.answer: The final outcomes remain assessment inputs rather than selection inputs.

exercises.title: Inspect the selected fit
exercises.task: Derive the case B intercept and slope.
exercises.hint: Use centered sums or the stated augmented system.
exercises.answer: An independent derivation checks the implementation and penalty convention.

exercises.title: Keep the final set separate
exercises.task: Alter only the final labels after selection.
exercises.expected: The chosen penalty must remain unchanged.
exercises.answer: If final labels change the selection, the procedure is leaking assessment information.

exercises.title: Reject nonidentification
exercises.task: Fit an unpenalized design with identical predictor values.
exercises.expected: The teaching helper raises an explicit error.
exercises.hint: A coefficient interpretation requires the declared rank condition.
exercises.answer: A numerical solution selection rule should not be mistaken for scientific identification.

exercises.title: Report scope
exercises.task: Use two final rows to describe the model.
exercises.expected: Report the observed error without a broad accuracy guarantee.
exercises.hint: The fixture was designed for arithmetic inspection.
exercises.answer: Real deployment evidence needs representative independent data, uncertainty and diagnostics.
